question.text: Under Regulation 18A, the compliance officer of a stock broker is required to report non-compliance to SEBI. Which statement best describes this obligation?

answer.text: Report non-compliance to SEBI on a quarterly basis through the stock exchange
Immediately and independently report to SEBI any non-compliance observed
Report to SEBI within 30 days of observing non-compliance
Report only material non-compliance to SEBI after board approval

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 18A requires the compliance officer to immediately and independently report to SEBI any non-compliance observed. The key words are 'immediately' and 'independently'. The Trap: 'Quarterly basis' is tempting because many reports are filed quarterly, but non-compliance reporting must be immediate, not periodic. Reporting only after board approval would contradict the independence requirement. Note: The source pages also summarise reporting of non-compliance to SEBI and to the Board of Directors; the obligation here is specifically immediate and independent reporting to SEBI.
